manifesto.body: For thirty years, HUB Surface Systems has connected Canadian communities with pavement technologies that do more than carry traffic. Decorative crosswalks. Civic plazas. Indigenous recognition art. Transit lanes. Parks. Driveways. Surfaces that carry meaning.

why_hub.subtitle: Specified by engineers. Loved by communities.
stats: Installations across Canada, coast to coast
proof: Stress-tested for de-icing salts, snowplow blades, and the cycles that destroy paint.
Thermoplastic and MMA last 6 to 8 times longer than paint — with no annual repaint window.
High-contrast decorative thermoplastic. Retroreflective regulatory markings where required. Slip-resistant by design.
Trusted by transportation engineers, urban designers, and municipal procurement from Vancouver to Halifax.

products.name: TrafficPatternsXD
products.tagline: When the surface has to hold.
products.title: Heavy-duty thermoplastic.
products.italic: 150-mil aggregate-reinforced. Built for BRT corridors and high-volume intersections.
products.callout_unit: Aggregate-reinforced preformed thermoplastic — performance aggregate through full cross-section
products.body: TrafficPatternsXD is HUB's heaviest thermoplastic — 150-mil preformed material with performance aggregate reinforced through the full cross-section. Delivers exceptional skid resistance under wet-surface bus traffic, turning movements, and concentrated wheel loads where painted markings and lighter thermoplastics fail. Heat-fused permanently to asphalt or concrete. Specified by Canadian transit authorities and municipalities coast to coast for BRT corridors, high-volume crosswalks, and bus stop pads.

products.name: TrafficPatterns
products.tagline: Outlasts paint by seasons, not months.
products.title: Standard thermoplastic.
products.callout_unit: Preformed thermoplastic — anti-skid aggregate intermixed through full cross-section
products.body: Factory-manufactured preformed thermoplastic at 125mil — heat-fused to asphalt or concrete with anti-skid aggregate (Mohs 8, 60 BPN) intermixed through the full cross-section. Holds high-contrast colour through snowplow cycles and de-icing salt seasons where paint requires annual reapplication. Customizable designs and colours let planners embed community character and identity into the crosswalk itself. Open to traffic within hours of installation.

products.name: StreetBond
products.tagline: Coloured pavement that moves with asphalt.
products.title: The colour system.
products.italic: Flexible acrylic engineered to resist peeling, cracking, and fading.
products.callout_unit: Full custom matching plus standard palette — bike lanes, plazas, driveways
products.body: Flexible acrylic engineered to move with the pavement — resisting the cracking from excessive hardness, premature wear from excessive flexibility, and slipperiness from overly smooth surfaces that compromise inferior coatings. Available in 37 standard colours — 17 Traditional, 20 Signature — plus full custom Pantone matching. 30–50 sq ft per gallon.

products.name: StreetPrint
products.tagline: Stamped asphalt at a fraction of stone's lifecycle cost.
products.title: Stamped asphalt.
products.callout_unit: Standard patterns — brick, cobblestone, slate, herringbone, fan, and custom
products.body: In-place stamped asphalt that impresses brick, cobblestone, slate, herringbone, and fan patterns directly into new or existing asphalt — sealed with StreetBond UV-stable colour. The finished surface is flush with the road: no raised edges, no shear risk under snowplows, no joints to weed. 12+ standard patterns plus fully custom designs. The visual richness of traditional stone without the maintenance.

products.name: DecoMark
products.title: Custom graphics.
products.italic: Pride crosswalks. Indigenous art. Civic landmarks at street scale.
products.callout_unit: Vector artwork to Pantone-accurate pavement graphics
products.body: A crosswalk is a canvas. DecoMark is how you paint it permanently. Precision preformed thermoplastic, fabricated to your vector artwork and Pantone colour, heat-fused to the road. Pride crosswalks. Indigenous cultural recognition art. Neighbourhood identity installations. Mural-scale public art that lets the street tell a community's story.

products.name: MMAX
products.tagline: Traffic-ready overnight. Engineered for transit lanes.
products.title: MMA resin lane coating.
products.italic: Methyl methacrylate. 45–60 min cure. Applies at +3°C and rising.
products.callout_unit: Cure to traffic-ready — complete overnight installation in a single maintenance window
products.body: MMA resin that cures to traffic-ready in 45–60 minutes, enabling complete overnight installation in active transit corridors without disrupting weekday operations. Embedded aggregates deliver superior traction under wet conditions. UV-stable pigments resist seasonal fading. Applies at +3°C and rising. The specification for red bus lanes, protected bike lanes, and BRT station zones where cure window and durability outlast painted and acrylic alternatives.

products.name: StreetBondSR
products.title: Cool surface coating.
products.italic: Initial Solar Reflectance ≥ 0.33. LEED v4 SS Credit: Heat Island Reduction.
products.callout_unit: ≥ 0.33 initial Solar Reflectance — meets LEED v4 Heat Island threshold
products.body: Solar reflective acrylic coating with Initial Solar Reflectance ≥ 0.33 — meeting the LEED v4 SS Credit: Heat Island Reduction threshold for non-roof hardscape. Same flexible chemistry and adhesion characteristics as StreetBond. Reduces pavement surface temperatures, mitigates urban heat island, and supports climate action plan implementation. Available in eleven SRI-rated tones plus custom Pantone matching.

products.name: DuraTherm
products.title: Inlaid thermoplastic.
products.italic: Embedded into a milled groove. Zero profile above grade.
products.callout_unit: Inlaid into milled asphalt groove — sits at road surface level
products.body: Preformed thermoplastic inlaid into a milled groove in the asphalt so the finished surface sits flush with the road — zero raised edges, zero profile for plow blades, no shear risk through Canadian winter maintenance cycles. No trip hazard. Combines decorative visual richness with skid-resistant surface treatment. The specification for markings that must survive heavy snow clearing without seasonal damage.

products.name: DuraShield
products.tagline: Maintain a surface, do not replace it.
products.title: Pavement maintenance coating.
products.callout_unit: Solar Reflectance — cools the surface and protects asphalt from UV and heat degradation
products.body: Two-component waterborne epoxy-modified acrylic coating for asphalt maintenance in pedestrian areas and residential roadways. Solar Reflectance 0.34 — cools the pavement surface and protects the substrate from UV, chemical, and heat degradation. Chemical-resistant: fuel, oil, and deicing agents. Available with anti-slip aggregate. Low VOC.

products.name: PreMark
products.title: Road marking symbols.
products.italic: Arrows. Stop bars. Legends. Bike pictographs. No stencils.
products.callout_unit: Standard thickness — 90mil ViziGrip option for lighter-duty applications
products.body: Preformed thermoplastic symbols pre-cut to specification: turn arrows, stop bars, yield triangles, school zone legends, bicycle pictographs, accessible parking symbols, and crosswalk ladder lines. 125mil standard. Heat-applied via propane torch — open to traffic immediately, no curing window, no stencils. Intersection-grade glass bead retroreflectivity outlasts painted markings by seasons without annual reapplication.

products.name: AirMark
products.title: Airfield thermoplastic.
products.italic: Preformed. Heat-applied. Engineered to airfield marking standards.
products.callout_unit: Service life vs. painted alternatives — full-depth glass bead
products.body: Airfield markings are safety-critical. Precision, visibility, and permanence are not negotiable. AirMark preformed thermoplastic is engineered to airfield marking standards, delivering consistent dimensional accuracy, premium retroreflectivity through full-depth glass bead construction, and a service life that outlasts paint by four to one. Heat-applied by certified crews to asphalt and concrete airfield surfaces. The choice for airports and aerodrome operators who need markings that hold their specification year-round.

applications.name: Crosswalks
applications.body: TrafficPatterns and TrafficPatternsXD thermoplastic hold ASTM-rated skid resistance and high-contrast colour through snowplow cycles and de-icing seasons where paint fails within a year. DecoMark and StreetBond open the intersection as a canvas — Pride crossings, Indigenous cultural art, neighbourhood identity. Specified by municipalities from Halifax to Vancouver.

applications.name: Pedestrian Safety
applications.body: Pedestrian safety isn't aesthetic aspiration — it's a measurable outcome. Retroreflective regulatory markings. High-contrast decorative thermoplastic that persists through de-icing salt cycles. The complete specification for engineers taking Vision Zero seriously.

applications.name: Bike Lanes
applications.tagline: Visibility that holds, season after season.
applications.body: A faded bike lane is a dangerous bike lane. StreetBond UV-stable acrylic and MMAX MMA resin maintain vivid colour through years of traffic and weather without chalking or fading. Bond strength above 3 MPa for cured MMAX zones.

applications.name: Bus Lanes
applications.tagline: Engineered for the harshest urban loads.
applications.body: BRT corridors are among the most demanding surfaces in any city's network. MMAX MMA resin cures to traffic-ready in 45–60 minutes, enabling complete overnight installation without disrupting weekday service. TrafficPatternsXD aggregate-reinforced thermoplastic delivers high skid resistance at bus stops and turning movements. Both outlast painted markings season after season.

applications.name: Traffic Calming
applications.body: Colour changes driver behaviour. Gateway treatments, speed table surface markings, and intersection colour reduce vehicle entry speeds without requiring physical barriers that impede emergency response.

applications.name: Parks & Paths
applications.body: The path through a park sets the tone for the whole space. StreetBond applies vivid UV-stable colour to existing surfaces. DecoMark brings mural-quality custom graphics. StreetPrint gives plazas the visual richness of stone.

applications.name: Playgrounds
applications.tagline: Vibrant, slip-resistant, built for hard use.
applications.body: Children are hard on surfaces. DecoMark thermoplastic brings hopscotch courts, number grids, compass roses, and mural-scale artwork to play surfaces with Pantone-accurate colour and flush-surface edges that eliminate trip hazards.

applications.name: Splash Pads
applications.tagline: Slip-resistant. Cool to touch. Vivid colour.
applications.body: Splash pad surfaces are uniquely demanding: constant water exposure, chemical treatments, bare feet. StreetBond builds a slip-resistant texture meeting wet-surface safety standards while delivering vivid, engaging colour.

applications.name: Sport Courts
applications.tagline: Court colour and lines that hold their geometry.
applications.body: Sport courts are one of the most demanding colour environments in outdoor pavement. StreetBond bonds permanently to asphalt and acid-etched concrete, delivering vivid colours and crisp line markings that hold through hard play.

applications.name: Public Spaces
applications.tagline: Civic plazas, transit forecourts, university campuses.
applications.body: Public plazas and civic squares are the most visible surfaces in any community. StreetPrint stamped asphalt transforms grey paved plazas into rich hardscape environments. StreetBond defines civic zones. Installed at UBC, BC Children's Hospital, and civic plazas coast to coast.

applications.name: Public Art
applications.body: The street is one of the largest untapped canvases in any city. HUB public art installations turn that canvas into permanent, weather-resistant community expression. From BC Children's Hospital labyrinth to UBC Indigenous cultural crosswalks.

applications.name: Community Branding
applications.tagline: Neighbourhood identity, embedded in the street.
applications.body: Every neighbourhood has a story. Most go untold on the street. DecoMark embeds Pantone-accurate custom graphics directly into asphalt: First Nations cultural artwork, BIA wayfinding, neighbourhood crests, Pride declarations, heritage commemorations.

applications.name: LEED & Heat Island
applications.body: Standard dark asphalt absorbs most solar radiation. StreetBondSR — Initial Solar Reflectance ≥ 0.33 — meets the LEED v4 SS Credit: Heat Island Reduction threshold for non-roof hardscape. Reduces surface temperatures and mitigates urban heat island. The specification for LEED-certified developments and climate action plan commitments.

applications.name: Commercial Spaces
applications.tagline: Premium hardscape. Mixed-use developments and hospitality.
applications.body: Retail centres, mixed-use developments, hotel porte-cocheres. The surface underfoot signals the quality of everything inside. StreetPrint delivers the visual weight of premium stone paving at a fraction of full installation cost.

applications.name: Townhomes
applications.body: Townhome and strata developments live and die by their first impression. StreetPrint stamped asphalt driveways and entry courts deliver the look of clay pavers or stone cobble at a fraction of the cost — no settling, no weeding.

applications.name: Private Driveways
applications.body: StreetPrint offers in-place stamped asphalt that works with the driveway already there, impressing cobblestone, brick, herringbone, or slate patterns directly into the surface, then sealing it with StreetBond colour.

applications.name: Parking Lots
applications.tagline: Looks maintained, performs safely, costs less.
applications.body: Parking lots take a disproportionate beating. DuraShield asphalt maintenance coating (SR 0.34) protects oxidized surfaces from UV, heat, and chemical degradation. PreMark retroreflective and TrafficPatterns high-contrast thermoplastic stall markings hold up without annual repainting. StreetBond creates branded wayfinding zones and fire lane designations.

projects.name: York Region VIVA BRT
projects.title: BRT corridor, open in 90 minutes.
projects.story: MMAX red MMA resin bus lane markings for York Region's VIVA Rapid Transit corridor — one of Canada's highest-ridership BRT networks. Bond strength above 3 MPa. Applied overnight. Open to full bus traffic in 90 minutes. No daytime closure. No paint cycle.

projects.name: Toronto Priority Bus Lanes
projects.title: Twelve corridors. One transit network.
projects.story: MMAX red resin treatments across 12 priority bus corridors in Toronto — one of the largest single-contract MMA deployments in Canada. One overnight cure window per corridor. No daytime closures. No repaint cycle. The specification TTC engineers reach for when painted alternatives have already failed.

projects.name: London East Link BRT
projects.title: A transit corridor with a clear identity.
projects.story: StreetBond coloured pavement across London Transit's East Link BRT priority corridor — vivid red lanes that communicate bus priority immediately to every driver on the road. Colour-stable through Ontario freeze-thaw cycles. No annual repaint window. A branded transit corridor built for the long term.

projects.name: BC Children's Hospital
projects.title: Playful surfaces. Healing spaces.
projects.story: StreetBond coatings and DecoMark surface graphics — including a meditation labyrinth — installed across active wards and ground-level plazas at BC Children's Hospital. Designed with Connect Landscape Architecture. The surfaces are slip-resistant, chemical-resistant, and built to perform in a healthcare environment.

projects.name: New Westminster Complete Streets
projects.title: Modal clarity, written in colour.
projects.story: Complete Streets across New Westminster: StreetBond green for protected bike lanes, TrafficPatterns high-contrast crosswalks, high-contrast colour at every conflict point. Modal priority made legible. Cyclists protected. Pedestrians seen. The Complete Streets specification that transportation engineers and urban planners return to.

projects.name: York Region Pedestrian Safety
projects.title: Outlasts paint by eight times.
projects.story: TrafficPatternsXD 150-mil aggregate-reinforced crosswalk markings specified across York Region intersections. Eight times the service life of paint. A measurable reduction in annual maintenance spend. The kind of lifecycle arithmetic that procurement teams and transportation engineers notice — and specify again.

projects.name: Vision Zero Crosswalks
projects.title: High-visibility holds lives.
projects.story: Where painted crosswalks fade by spring, high-contrast thermoplastic holds its colour through every season. Specified by municipalities from Halifax to Victoria pursuing Vision Zero — the standard for engineers who need pedestrian safety outcomes, not just pedestrian safety intentions.

projects.name: Vancouver BIA Crosswalks
projects.title: District identity, cast in pavement.
projects.story: StreetPrint stamped-asphalt crosswalks across five Vancouver Business Improvement Districts. District identity embedded permanently in the street — walked over every day, maintaining visual coherence through snowplow seasons and years of traffic load.

projects.name: UBC Musqueam Crosswalk
projects.title: A surface is also a statement.
projects.story: A collaboration with UBC and the Musqueam Nation. Coast Salish art patterns stamped into asphalt at the centre of campus — an institutional acknowledgement made permanent, at street scale, in a material that will outlast the generation that commissioned it.

projects.name: More Awesome Now
projects.title: Six laneways. Six artists.
projects.story: Six Vancouver laneways. Six artists. StreetBond coloured pavement turned utility corridors into civic gallery space — public art at street scale, permanent and weather-resistant.

projects.name: White Rock Pier
projects.title: Salt air. Holiday traffic. Held.
projects.story: Salt spray. Summer surge. Winter rain. The pier crosswalk at White Rock faces the full force of the BC coast — and holds season after season. TrafficPatternsXD installed where paint would be gone by July.

projects.name: Indigenous Recognition
projects.title: Recognition, cast in pavement.
projects.story: Indigenous Recognition crosswalks honouring First Nations communities across Canada. Every design co-developed with community elders and knowledge keepers. Permanent. Visible at every crossing. Walked by the whole city.

projects.name: Kitchener Veterans Memorial
projects.title: Paint fades. Memory shouldn't.
projects.story: Kitchener's Veterans Crosswalk: a permanent civic tribute walked over every day. DecoMark thermoplastic graphic embedded into the street — durable enough to outlast the paint that failed before it, respectful enough to honour what it commemorates.

projects.name: Every Child Matters
projects.title: Honouring residential schools survivors.
projects.story: Town of Georgina honours the Every Child Matters movement with a permanent TrafficPatterns thermoplastic crosswalk. A civic acknowledgement cast in durable material — walked over every day, visible every season.

projects.name: Sechelt Pictograph Crosswalk
projects.title: The origin story of the shishalh Nation.
projects.story: Indigenous artists Dionne Paul and Lindsey Kyoko Adams told the origin story of the shishalh Nation in TrafficPatterns thermoplastic at Cowrie and Trail in Sechelt. Unveiled during National Aboriginal History Month — cultural memory made permanent at street level.

projects.name: Simcoe Rainbow Crosswalk
projects.title: Two years of fundraising. One street.
projects.story: A young Simcoe resident's two-year fundraising campaign, realized in TrafficPatternsXD by Multiseal. A rainbow crosswalk that holds colour and skid resistance season after season — long after painted alternatives would have faded from memory.

projects.name: Bowen Island Path
projects.title: Forest. Sunset. Water. Earth.
projects.story: A community art path at Snug Cove, Bowen Island. Custom StreetBond in four colours — forest, sunset, water, and earth — community identity built permanently into the surface of the path that connects the village to the waterfront.

projects.name: Murrayville Schoolhouse
projects.title: A schoolhouse, a sidewalk, a memory.
projects.story: StreetPrint stamped-asphalt sidewalk linking the historic Murrayville Schoolhouse to the community around it. Heritage-look surface for a heritage building — brick-pattern asphalt that reads as stone and performs as pavement.

projects.name: White Rock Seaside Stroll
projects.title: The waterfront, brought inland.
projects.story: White Rock commissioned Vancouver artist Amy Bao to carry the coastal identity of the waterfront into the Uptown district on Johnston Road. Her 'Seaside Stroll' — flowing wave lines in the tones of White Rock's sandy beaches — was realized in TrafficPatterns preformed thermoplastic. Permanent. UV-stable. Slip-resistant. In its first season, Uptown reported 40% more foot traffic to the district.

projects.name: Langley Railroad Heritage
projects.title: Heritage cast in thermoplastic.
projects.story: Langley City's crosswalk at the entrance to Linwood Park connects modern pedestrian infrastructure to the city's railway history. Railroad tie-and-rail pattern in preformed TrafficPatterns thermoplastic — tan panels mimicking wooden rail ties, white lines suggesting steel rails, fused permanently to the asphalt. Installed by Square One Paving, March 2025. A social media landmark before the crew had packed up.

installers.name: Square One Paving
installers.body: BC's certified StreetPrint and decorative thermoplastic installer. From stamped-asphalt driveways in Langley strata developments to municipal streetscapes — outstanding outcomes for municipalities, developers, and contractors across British Columbia.

installers.name: Thermo Design
installers.body: Spécialiste québécois en marquage de longue durée. Crosswalk programs, bus lane markings, and decorative surface systems for Quebec municipalities and commercial sites — built to survive Quebec winters.

installers.name: Virtue Construction
installers.body: Quality Saskatchewan outcomes since 2009. TrafficPatterns crosswalks, StreetBond colour systems, and full HUB portfolio installation for Saskatchewan municipalities and communities — from Saskatoon to rural intersections that specify by name.

installers.name: ULS Landscaping
installers.body: 10+ years of professional landscape management with certified HUB decorative paving installation across Alberta and Saskatchewan. Parks, pathways, residential driveways, and commercial sites — precision installation, backed by experience.
